Rashi on Chullin 6a:1:1.hebrew: ואי ס"ד לא קבלה - רבי זירא מרבי יעקב דר"ג לגמרי אסר, מאי קשיא ליה:
Rashi on Chullin 6a:1:1.english: And if it enters your mind that he did not accept it - [if you say] that Rabbi Zeira [understood] from Rabbi Yaakov that Rabban Gamliel prohibited it entirely, what difficulty would he have [in resolving it a different way]?

Rashi on Chullin 6a:1:2.hebrew: לישני ליה - לנפשיה, כי אסר ר"ג, כשאין ישראל עומד על גביו, דלית ליה "לפני עור לא תתן מכשול", וכי אכל רבי יוחנן, כשישראל עומד על גביו:
Rashi on Chullin 6a:1:2.english: Let him resolve it for himself - Rabban Gamliel's prohibition was stated in a case where a Jew was not standing over him [the Samaritan], for in that case there is no concern of "you shall not place a stumbling block before the blind." And when Rabbi Yochanan ate [from the Samaritan's slaughter], it was in a case where a Jew was standing over him.

Rashi on Chullin 6a:2:1.english: And put a knife to your throat - This is a verse in the book of Proverbs.

Rashi on Chullin 6a:2:2.hebrew: אם בעל נפש אתה - אם אדם כשר אתה, כדאמר בפסחים (דף מ.): בעל נפש לא ילתות, אדם כשר:
Rashi on Chullin 6a:2:2.english: If you are a ba'al nefesh - If you are a proper person, as it says in Pesachim (40a): "A ba'al nefesh does not soak [grain]" - [meaning] a proper person.

Rashi on Chullin 6a:2:3.english: Your throat - [Meaning] your cheeks. That is to say, restrain yourself against your [evil] inclination and do not do this.

Rashi on Chullin 6a:3:1.hebrew: מצאו להן - אותם היושבים בהר גריזים ונעשו מומרים לעבודת כוכבים. ואע"ג דרוב כותים לאו מהר גריזים היו, רבי מאיר לטעמיה דחייש למיעוטא, ביבמות (דף סא:): קטן וקטנה לא חולצין ולא מיבמין, דברי ר"מ. אמרו לו לר"מ: יפה אמרת לא חולצין, איש כתיב בפרשה, מפני מה לא מיבמין? אמר להן: קטן שמא ימצא סריס, קטנה שמא תמצא איילונית, ונמצאו פוגעים בערוה. ולא אמר רוב קטנים אינם סריסים:
Rashi on Chullin 6a:3:1.english: They found for themselves - Those who dwelled on Mount Gerizim and became apostates for idol worship. And even though most Samaritans (Kuthim) were not from Mount Gerizim, Rabbi Meir is consistent with his own reasoning, that he is concerned for the minority, [as taught] in [tractate] Yevamot (61b): A minor boy and a minor girl do not perform chalitzah and do not perform levirate marriage (yibum) - these are the words of Rabbi Meir. They said to Rabbi Meir: You have said well that they do not perform chalitzah, since "a man" is written in that passage - but why do they not perform yibum? He said to them: A minor boy - lest he be found to be a eunuch; a minor girl - lest she be found to be infertile (aylonit) - and they would then be found to be engaging in a forbidden relation. And he did not say that most minors are not eunuchs [and rely on that majority].

Rashi on Chullin 6a:4:1.english: a ruler over you - [Meaning] a great [scholar] in Torah.

Rashi on Chullin 6a:5:1.english: If he knows about his teacher - [Meaning,] that if he asks him, he will give him the reason.

Rashi on Chullin 6a:5:3.hebrew: ואם לאו תבין את אשר לפניך - מעצמך, ואל תשאל ותביישנו, ושמת סכין בלועך בתריה דהאי קרא כתיב, כלומר התחזק עצמך ועצור פיך מלשאול:
Rashi on Chullin 6a:5:3.english: And if not, "consider well what is before you" - [figure it out] on your own, and do not ask him and thereby embarrass him. "And put a knife to your throat" is written right after this verse, meaning: strengthen yourself and restrain your mouth from asking.

Rashi on Chullin 6a:5:4.english: If you are a person of conscience - and you desire to ask and get to the bottom of the matter, what is his remedy? Separate yourself from him.

Rashi on Chullin 6a:7:1.hebrew: מהתם גזרו - ר"מ על היין, ורבן גמליאל אחריו על השחיטה:
Rashi on Chullin 6a:7:1.english: From there they decreed - Rabbi Meir [decreed] concerning wine, and Rabban Gamliel after him concerning slaughter.

Rashi on Chullin 6a:7:2.hebrew: וקבלו מינייהו - לא שאלו גדולים הימנו, אלא שבדורו של ר"מ לא רצו לקבל עליהם לפרוש מן הכותיים לפי שהיו רגילים בהם, ובדורו של רבי אמי היה אפשר להם לפרוש:
Rashi on Chullin 6a:7:2.english: And they accepted [it] from them - It is not that they asked [permission] from those greater than themselves; rather, in the generation of Rabbi Meir (R"M), they were unwilling to accept upon themselves to separate from the Samaritans (Kuthim), because they were accustomed to them, whereas in the generation of Rabbi Ami it was possible for them to separate.

Tosafot on Chullin 6a:2:1.hebrew: אשכחיה ההוא סבא - י"מ דכל מקום שהוא מזכיר "ההוא סבא" הוא אליהו, ואי אפשר לומר כן בפרק "במה מדליקין" (שבת דף לד.) בעובדא דרבי שמעון בן יוחאי:
Tosafot on Chullin 6a:2:1.english: A certain old man found him - Some explain that every place where it mentions "a certain old man" (ההוא סבא), it is Eliyahu. But it is not possible to say this in the chapter "Bameh Madlikin" (Shabbat 34a), in the incident involving Rabbi Shimon ben Yochai.

Tosafot on Chullin 6a:3:1.english: On the peak of Mount Gerizim - According to the Midrash, this is the idol that Jacob buried under the terebinth on the mountain of Shechem (Genesis 35).

Tosafot on Chullin 6a:5:1.hebrew: אם בעל נפש אתה פרוש הימנו - דבסיפא דקרא כתיב "ואל תתאו למטעמותיו":
Tosafot on Chullin 6a:5:1.english: If you are a person of desire (ba'al nefesh), keep away from it - For in the latter part of the verse it is written: "and do not desire his delicacies" (Mishlei 23:3).
